title: Voice Notes Manager App | Full-Stack MERN + AI (OpenAI API)

Automatic transcription of audio using OpenAI Whisper API
AI-powered summaries and insights from notes
CRUD functionality for managing notes (create, edit, delete)
Responsive React UI with intuitive design
